subject: Copywriting
title: The CAN-SPAM Act
description: A fast breakdown of The CAN-SPAM Act for builders.

hook.text: By 2003, spam was 45% of all email. Congress passed the CAN-SPAM Act. For the first time, email marketing had rules.

buildup.text: CAN-SPAM required honest subject lines, a physical address, and a working unsubscribe link in every commercial email.

discovery.text: Legitimate marketers welcomed it. Rules separated them from spammers and increased consumer trust in email.

twist.text: Penalties reached $46,517 per violation. But enforcement was weak and spam continued to grow despite the law.

climax.text: GDPR in 2018 went further: explicit consent required before sending. Email marketing shifted from opt-out to opt-in.

punchline.text: Consent became mandatory. Permission email is the only email now.

quiz.question: What did the CAN-SPAM Act require in every email?
